Method of Attack: Causes Windows Start menu to become unresponsive and some applications to no longer launch
Damages registry keys or data affecting apps using Microsoft Office APIs to integrate with Windows, Microsoft Office, or Microsoft Outlook or Outlook Calendar
Attack Vector: Update to an affected app that exposes the underlying issue
Apps integrating with Windows, Microsoft Office, Microsoft Outlook or Outlook Calendar
Indicators of Compromise: Issues logging into Azure Active Directory to activate Office 365 apps
